is a Japanese video game developer founded by composer Yuzo Koshiro, his mother, and his sister on April 1, 1990. The company has worked on games such as the 8-bit version of Sonic the Hedgehog, Streets of Rage 2, Beyond Oasis, Shenmue, and Gotta Protectors, among others.

* Streets of Rage 2 – Sega Genesis, 1992

* Robotrek – Super NES, 1994
* Beyond Oasis – Sega Genesis, 1995
